draft.emotion: firm and steady, putting muscle behind the movement
notes: Contrasts with τραβάω / τραβώ (to pull). The aorist stem is σπρώξ- (έσπρωξα).

senses.definition: To apply physical force to something or someone in order to move them away.

examples.text: Μην σπρώχνεις την πόρτα, τράβηξέ την.
examples.translation: Don't push the door, pull it.
examples.emotion: stern and corrective, warning someone not to force it the wrong way

examples.text: Έσπρωξε το κουτί μακριά για να κάνει χώρο.
examples.translation: He pushed the box away to make room.
examples.emotion: practical and deliberate, clearing space on a surface
